name: caveman-dashboard
description: Track token savings from the caveman output-compression plugin across Claude Code and GitHub Copilot, right inside VS Code.

cavemanDashboard.showCost.description: Show estimated USD cost figures alongside token savings (Claude Code only).

cavemanDashboard.claudeProjectsPath.description: Override the Claude config directory used to read caveman history and transcripts. Defaults to $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or ~/.claude.

cavemanDashboard.vscodeUserPath.description: Override the VS Code User directory used to find GitHub Copilot chat transcripts. Defaults to the per-OS location.

scripts.compile: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle
scripts.bundle: rm -rf out && mkdir -p out && esbuild src/extension.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --external:vscode --outfile=out/extension.js
